============================

This file applies to vendor/p5.min.js, the unmodified p5.js 1.9.0 browser
distribution. The inventory is based on the p5.js v1.9.0 source tree,
package-lock.json, published npm packages, and the corresponding unminified
browser bundle. Components are listed even when Flow Phenomenon does not call
their APIs directly, because their code is present in the redistributed file.
